name: status
title: Status
description: A status badge with an animated ping indicator and five colour variants for system states, user presence and service health.

name: direction-provider
title: Direction Provider
description: Provides bidirectional text support (RTL/LTR) across your application, with a reader that falls back to the nearest DOM dir attribute when no provider is present.

name: pending
title: Pending
description: A utility that disables interactions, keeps keyboard focus and wires the correct ARIA state for buttons, forms, links, switches and any interactive element while it is pending.

name: stat
title: Stat
description: A card for a key metric — label, value, colour-themed indicator, trend, separator and description — laid out on a two-column grid that positions its parts by slot.

name: swap
title: Swap
description: A component that swaps between two states with click or hover activation modes.

name: color-swatch
title: Color Swatch
description: A color swatch component for displaying color values with support for transparency and various sizes.

name: circular-progress
title: Circular Progress
description: A circular progress indicator that displays completion progress in a ring format with support for indeterminate states.
